PLAN.admission: All scheduled combinations; independent initial-world semantic validator; record every rejection before expert calls. No success/optimality filters. Warmup is inherited lived WAIT history; truncation reported.
PLAN.actionSet: Complete frozen symmetric offered menu. Canonical-frame ordering is evaluator-side only; adapters receive opaque handles and declared type/target, never canonical frame.
PLAN.oracle: FORGE_COUNTERFACTUAL_SYMMETRIC_V1 / FORGE_REWARD_V2 / GREEDY_CONTINUATION_V1; H0=0 continuation steps, H2=3. Conditional policy value, NOT exhaustive globally optimal planning.

metrics.hit: fraction of uniformly selected set in conditional optimal set
metrics.regret: optimal conditional utility minus selected conditional utility
metrics.normalizedRegret: regret divided by offered-menu utility spread; zero if tied
metrics.abstention: coverage plus null conditional metrics; no invented fallback utility
metrics.falseSelectionHarm: paired normalized regret of synthesis minus the specialist, positive part; null if either abstains

Oracle consumer unavailable: protocol no-change is measurable, reasoning MEV NOT_TESTABLE. Nexus removal leaves no action: regret/DDV delta NOT_TESTABLE; report coverage loss, not zero value.
PLAN.stress: Actual qualified outputs from preceding different observation + genuine current bundle duplicated/reversed; no fabricated controllers. Rejection safety is software qualification, not a claim of competence improvement.

doctrine.DRI: Reorder candidates and clone identical observed packet; validate independently equal evaluator optimal sets. Stability does not mean competence.
doctrine.DRS: Observable actor-health intervention +10 bounded to100 on first 12 scheduled rows of each panel; truth labels recomputed, same offered action set required, disjoint optimal sets required for false-stability diagnosis; overlap reported. No outcome-driven admission.

PLAN.improvement: Do not tune on these results. Diagnose inherited selector against strong S0. No new reasoning head without attributable deficiency and explicit paired follow-up plan.
PLAN.inference: Descriptive OPEN diagnostics only; independent seed panels in known composition are not structural OOD or sealed replication. No CIs marketed as confirmatory.
